note: The coverage rule, held in one place: check-constraints.py --coverage reads this file. A move's constraints file maps every defect below either to the ids of hard constraints, or to {"not_applicable": "<reason>"}. A covering constraint counts only when it (1) is hard, (2) cites as `source` the sha256 of a verified source (match exact or normalised, in docs/anim/sources/ or this plugin's skills/_shared/sources/), (3) has one of the defect's `natures`, so it measures the defect itself rather than a sign or a side, and (4) is evaluable on the project: every bone, prop and landmark it names is in the rig map, and every marker it names is declared for its clip (rig map `clips.<clip>.markers`). A defect whose `required_when` holds cannot be not_applicable, and a not_applicable whose reason matches `deferral` points at another move: each move covers the defects that apply to it. Anything else refuses the spec.

defects.what: A held weapon, a closed fist or a shield beats against the body during locomotion instead of riding with the torso.

natures.label: frame_pose stability in the torso's frame (stat peak_to_peak)
trajectory path_length relative to the torso (relative_to)

defects.hint: Speed or peak-to-peak displacement of the hands, pommel and tip in the chest's frame, on the locomotion clips.

defects.what: A cut whose tip travels along its own blade axis, driven by the wrist rather than the shoulder: it reads as a stab.

natures.label: edge angle at contact (vector_angle, stat at)

defects.hint: Tip velocity against the blade axis (velocity_axis_angle), the arc of the tip, the edge's angle at the contact marker.

defects.what: A weapon hand that reads as the other hand: the forearm turned past its range, the hand mirrored, or the fingers closed on the wrong side of the grip.

natures.label: rotation of the forearm or the wrist (joint_angle on a forearm, hand or wrist bone)

defects.hint: Forearm twist and wrist rotation against the anatomy table; handedness and the grip checks are sign tests that a pronated hand passes, so they may be added but never cover.
